title: Command injection via sprintf + system() with unsanitised parameters in tunnel_up()
detail: src/aurora/aurora-network/src/tunnel.c:L19 constructs a shell command with sprintf using the caller-supplied 'name' and 'remote' parameters, then L20 executes it via system(); no validation or escaping is performed, allowing shell metacharacters in either parameter to inject arbitrary commands.

title: Command injection via snprintf + system() with unsanitised parameter in tunnel_down()
detail: src/aurora/aurora-network/src/tunnel.c:L26 uses snprintf to build a command incorporating the caller-supplied 'name' parameter, and L27 passes the result to system(); the 'name' string is not sanitised, allowing shell metacharacters to inject arbitrary commands.

title: Command injection via snprintf + system() with unsanitised parameter in tunnel_mtu()
detail: src/aurora/aurora-network/src/tunnel.c:L36 builds a shell command with snprintf including the caller-supplied 'name' parameter, and L37 executes it via system(); 'name' is not sanitised, so shell metacharacters in the caller's input can inject arbitrary commands.
